headline: Kuura Strand Erupts as Weathered Expanse Keeps Its Fires
war_summary: Fresh fighting has broken out since our last edition. Kuura Strand, quiet through the day, logged eight base actions inside two hours, five of them about Suosalo, and casualties on both sides passed two hundred apiece in that span alone, though the Warden flag still flies over all six posts there. Mooring County keeps its question open: fifty-two actions on the day, the last within the hour, Colonials holding two of twelve posts, losses near 7,900 against 8,700. The Weathered Expanse remains the furnace—seventy actions, Wightwalk twenty-six and Frostmarch twenty-one among them, the tally six Warden, one Colonial, two ruined, some 8,800 Colonial and 11,500 Warden down. In Linn Mercy the Wardens' capture of Lathair stands, and the hourly ledger there runs to roughly a thousand Warden and five hundred Colonial fallen. Marban Hollow's Checkpoint Bua took seventeen actions on the day. The Nevish Line raised no flag, yet its dead climb past four thousand on either side. Stlican Shelf saw fifteen actions about Briar and Breaker Town, one Warden post still standing. Day 577 of the war; thirty-four victory towns required; no victor named.
